fund_name.quote: Ashgrove Special Situations Fund, L.P. (the "Partnership") is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023.

fund_domicile.quote: is a limited partnership organized under the laws of the State of Delaware on January 19, 2023

fund_structure.value: Open-end Delaware LP investing directly. Not a master-feeder: there is no master fund and no offshore parallel vehicle; non-U.S. and tax-exempt investors invest directly. Two classes - Class F (Founders, closed to new investors) and Class I (Institutional).
fund_structure.quote: The Partnership invests directly and does not operate as a feeder into a master fund. There is no offshore parallel vehicle.

management_fee.value: 1.60% per annum of capital account net asset value, determined prior to accrual of the Incentive Allocation, accrued monthly and payable quarterly in arrears. Identical for Class F and Class I. This is the amended rate effective 1 January 2025 under Supplement No. 1; the 2.00% rate in Section 4.1 of the original Memorandum is superseded and no longer in effect.
management_fee.quote: The Partnership pays the Investment Manager a management fee accrued monthly and payable quarterly in arrears at an annual rate of 1.60% of the net asset value of each Limited Partner's capital account, determined prior to accrual of the Incentive Allocation.

performance_fee.value: Class F: 15% of Net New Appreciation. Class I: 20% of Net New Appreciation. Rates unchanged by Supplement No. 1, but note the Class I rate is now subject to a 4.00% preferred return added by Supplement No. 1, Section S-3. Incentive Period is each calendar year and also ends on any redemption.
performance_fee.quote: With respect to Class F Interests, the Incentive Allocation is 15% of Net New Appreciation.

hurdle_rate.value: Class I: 4.00% per annum preferred return, effective 1 January 2025, calculated on the opening capital account balance for each Incentive Period and adjusted pro rata for flows. It is a soft hurdle with full catch-up - once Net New Appreciation exceeds the preferred return, the Incentive Allocation applies to the entirety of Net New Appreciation, not just the excess. Does not compound across periods; shortfalls are not carried forward. Class F: no hurdle, measured on an absolute basis. The statement in Section 4.3 of the original Memorandum that no hurdle applies is superseded as to Class I.
hurdle_rate.quote: the Incentive Allocation of 20% of Net New Appreciation is, effective January 1, 2025, subject to a preferred return of 4.00% per annum, calculated on the opening capital account balance for each Incentive Period and adjusted pro rata for subscriptions and redemptions during the period

high_water_mark.value: Yes - perpetual, on a per-Limited-Partner and per-subscription basis. Does not reset over time, on a change in the Management Fee or Incentive Allocation rate, or on a change of control of the Investment Manager. Applies identically to Class F and Class I and is not amended by Supplement No. 1.
high_water_mark.quote: The Partnership maintains a perpetual high water mark on a per-Limited-Partner, per-subscription basis.

minimum_initial_investment.value: $1,000,000 minimum initial subscription for Class I Interests. This is unchanged - Supplement No. 1, Section S-6 raised only the minimum ADDITIONAL subscription, from $100,000 to $250,000, and expressly left the initial minimum at $1,000,000. Class F, now closed to new investors, had a $5,000,000 minimum.
minimum_initial_investment.quote: The minimum initial subscription for Class I Interests is $1,000,000, and the minimum additional subscription is $100,000.

lockup_period.value: No hard lock-up. A soft lock applies instead: interests redeemed within 18 months of the relevant subscription bear a 2.00% early redemption charge paid to the Partnership for the benefit of remaining Limited Partners. FIFO across subscriptions. No charge after 18 months. Not amended by Supplement No. 1.
lockup_period.quote: Interests are not subject to a hard lock-up. Instead, Interests redeemed within eighteen (18) months of the date of the relevant subscription are subject to an early redemption charge of 2.00% of the redemption proceeds

redemption_frequency.value: Quarterly - as of the last business day of each calendar quarter. Not amended by Supplement No. 1.
redemption_frequency.quote: Interests may be redeemed as of the last business day of each calendar quarter.

redemption_notice_days.value: 45 calendar days, effective 1 January 2025 under Supplement No. 1. The 60-day notice period stated in Section 5.3 of the original Memorandum is superseded and no longer in effect.
redemption_notice_days.quote: Written notice of redemption must be received by the Administrator not less than forty-five (45) calendar days prior to the applicable redemption date.

gate_provision.value: Fund-level gate at 25% of the Partnership's net asset value as of the applicable redemption date. No investor-level gate. Excess requests are reduced pro rata with the unsatisfied portion carried to the next redemption date with priority, subject to the gate then in effect. No limit on consecutive gated periods. The General Partner may waive the gate in whole or part, including for particular Limited Partners.
gate_provision.quote: Fund-level gate | 25% of the Partnership's net asset value as of the applicable redemption date

key_man_provision.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - the Partnership expressly provides no key person provision, key man clause or associated redemption right. The departure, death, disability or incapacity of Mr. Brannigan-Tate, or of any other person, triggers no redemption right, no suspension, and no notice obligation beyond that required by law. Limited Partners seeking key person protection must negotiate it individually by side letter, and the Investment Manager has historically declined to grant it.
key_man_provision.quote: the Partnership does not provide any key person provision, key man clause, or associated redemption right

gp_commitment.value: NOT_APPLICABLE - there is no required general partner commitment, no stated minimum dollar amount and no stated minimum percentage of net asset value. Mr. Brannigan-Tate and his family vehicles held approximately $4,200,000 (roughly 3.1% of net asset value) as of the date of the Memorandum, but this is disclosed as a statement of fact and is expressly stated not to constitute a commitment; it may be redeemed in whole or in part at any time without notice to Limited Partners.
gp_commitment.quote: The General Partner has not committed, and does not commit, to maintain any minimum investment in the Partnership. There is no required general partner commitment, no stated minimum dollar amount, and no stated minimum percentage of net asset value.

fund_term.value: Perpetual - continues until dissolved by the General Partner or as otherwise provided in the Limited Partnership Agreement. No fixed termination date and no investment period.
fund_term.quote: The Partnership has a perpetual term and continues until dissolved by the General Partner or as otherwise provided in the Limited Partnership Agreement. There is no fixed termination date and no investment period.

auditor.value: Wexley Sandoval Partners LLP, appointed effective for the fiscal year ending 31 December 2024 under Supplement No. 1, replacing Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP. Note that Section 9.2 and the Appendix B service-provider table of the original Memorandum still name Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP; those references are superseded. Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP continues to provide tax preparation services only, including Schedule K-1 preparation.
auditor.quote: Effective for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024, the Partnership has appointed Wexley Sandoval Partners LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm, replacing Ardmore Pike & Levinson LLP.

administrator.value: Kestrel Harbour Fund Administration, LLC - responsible for net asset value calculation, capital account maintenance, investor onboarding and anti-money laundering procedures. Not amended by Supplement No. 1.
administrator.quote: Kestrel Harbour Fund Administration, LLC serves as the Partnership's administrator

prime_broker.value: NOT_FOUND - no prime broker is named anywhere in the Memorandum or Supplement No. 1. The document describes custody only, at one or more qualified custodians under Rule 206(4)-2, and Appendix B lists no prime broker.

legal_counsel.value: Farrow Tindall Greaves LLP - counsel to the Partnership, the General Partner and the Investment Manager. Does not represent the Limited Partners.
legal_counsel.quote: Farrow Tindall Greaves LLP serves as counsel to the Partnership, the General Partner and the Investment Manager.

mfn_election.value: No - the Partnership expressly does not offer a most favored nation election. Side letter terms are not disclosed to, and will not be offered to, other Limited Partners.
mfn_election.quote: The Partnership does not offer a most favored nation election. Side letter terms are not disclosed to, and will not be offered to, other Limited Partners.
